controls.title: Current Vehicle
controls.desc:
Automatically detected from CAN fingerprint or manually selected.

🟢 = Auto-fingerprinted | 🔵 = Manual | 🟡 = Unrecognized

controls.title: Manual Vehicle Selection
controls.desc: Search for and manually select your vehicle if automatic fingerprinting fails or you want to override the detected vehicle.

controls.title: Remove Manual Selection
controls.desc: Remove the manually selected vehicle and return to automatic fingerprinting.

descriptions.off: This feature provides customized longitudinal control tuning for supported Hyundai/Kia/Genesis vehicles. Off: Use default longitudinal controls.
descriptions.dynamic: This feature provides customized longitudinal control tuning for supported Hyundai/Kia/Genesis vehicles. Dynamic: Smooth, dynamic response that adapts to driving conditions. • Better for highway cruising • More gradual acceleration/deceleration • Comfortable for passengers
descriptions.predictive: This feature provides customized longitudinal control tuning for supported Hyundai/Kia/Genesis vehicles. Predictive: Quick, responsive behavior for city driving. • Better for stop-and-go traffic • Faster reaction to lead vehicle changes • More aggressive acceleration/deceleration
descriptions.disabled:
Start the vehicle to check compatibility.
This feature requires openpilot longitudinal control to be available.
